text:
devon: noticed ~12% p95 regression for weight-only INT8 (AWQ) after merging hybrid-calib. rolling back now?

maria: ugh. numbers?

devon: production tail (api/redwood/generate) before/after:
```
p50: 28ms -> 29ms
p95: 112ms -> 125ms
median tokens/sec down ~9%
```

anil: any change in kernel selection logs? kernel router could be picking fallback.

devon: yes, router.log shows: `kernel=int8_group_v2 -> int8_unpack_serial` more frequently.

sam: unpack stage adds memcopy + dequantize, could be evicted from L2. what group size were you using?

devon: group_size=256 in deploy config. packing=true, prefetch=on

maria: try a quick repro on staging with group_size=128 and group_size=64. also capture CUPTI timeline.

devon: running now. attaching nvprof snippet:
```
GPU Kernel: int8_pack  time=3.2ms  (calls: 120)
GPU Kernel: int8_unpack time=1.9ms  (calls: 120)
DRAM BW spike correlates with unpack calls
```

elaine: similar to earlier L2 thrash bug — whenever group_size > 128 we see packing buffer growth and cache churn.

qa-jordan: also saw increased KV cache evictions in telemetry; maybe packing makes cache footprint bigger and causes more KV misses.

anil: hypothesis: hybrid-calib added per-tensor metadata which forced unpack+repack on hotpath for mixed AWQ+GPTQ models.

sam: temporary mitigation: enable `packing_stride=16` + `small_group_prefetch=true` so hot sequences don't trigger full unpack. config snippet:
```
"quant":{ "group_size":"128","packing_stride":"16","small_group_prefetch":"true" }
```

devon: applied to staging — p95 improved back ~7% relative to bad deploy. need perf test and safety patch.

maria: can you add kernel-level sampling in prod for 1% traffic and log `kernel_choice`, `group_size`, `kv_evictions` ? tag traces with `hybrid_calib=true`

devon: will do. also add a unit that simulates streaming chat to exercise KV cache.

infra-bot: deploy-plan: rolling canary 1% -> 10% -> 100% with metrics gates (p95, error-rate, kv-eviction-rate)

anil: longer-term: avoid per-request unpack+repack by annotating tensors with quant meta and plumb through runtime so kernel can do in-place decode.

maria: agreed. create an RFC and schedule a spike to evaluate kernel change vs prefetch heuristics.

devon: filing bug/issue: #INF-2143 with repro script and nvprof traces.

sam: thanks — great catch. :thumbsup:
